item.description:
Realistic Olive Tree Artificial Plant in Decorative Pot with Bonus Woven Basket, 4ft/ 5ft/ 6ft, Lifelike Greenery for Any Space, No Watering or Care Needed, Perfect for Home and Office Décor
 
Description:
Add a touch of natural beauty to your indoor space with this Artificial Olive Tree. Whether placed in your home , office , or store , it brings a refreshing green vibe and creates a cozy, nature-inspired atmosphere .
 
📣📣Main Features:
🌸🌸🌸Realistic Design: The branches and leaves are crafted using green realistic technology, perfectly replicating the appearance of a real olive tree . The silk-like leaves mimic the natural texture and feel of real foliage, offering a lifelike appearance that requires no watering or maintenance .
🌸🌸🌸Adjustable Branches: The tree branches contain soft metal wires, allowing you to easily adjust the angle of the leaves and branches to create a unique green corner that suits your preferences.
🌸🌸🌸High-Quality Materials: Made with premium plastic and fabric for durability and a realistic touch .
🌸🌸🌸Charming Small Woven Basket: Comes with a small woven basket (18cm diameter, 23cm base diameter, 21cm height)  to hold the tree, adding a rustic, cozy touch .
🌸🌸🌸No Maintenance: Unlike real plants , this artificial olive tree does not need sunlight , fertilization , or watering . It's easy to clean with a damp cloth , making it perfect for living rooms , bedrooms , offices , and other indoor spaces .
🌸🌸🌸Symbol of Peace and Hope: The olive tree is a symbol of peace ✌️, resilience , and the continuity of life , making it a meaningful addition to your space.
 
Available Sizes:
🎁🎁🎁🎁Height: 120cm / 4ft; 150cm / 5ft; 180cm / 6ft  (Choose according to your preference and available space).
Perfect for Multiple Spaces:
🎁🎁🎁🎁Indoor Decoration: This artificial olive tree is a great way to add green charm  to your living room , bedroom , study , or office , creating a relaxing and peaceful environment .
🎁🎁🎁🎁Outdoor Use: Ideal for sheltered outdoor areas such as balconies, courtyards , or porches , bringing a refreshing green element  to your outdoor space.
🎁🎁🎁🎁 Commercial Spaces: Perfect for stores , hotels , or lobby areas , this tree enhances the aesthetic of any commercial space and catches the eye  of customers.

❤❤❤❤❤
Additional Tips:
The carefully designed trunk  and branches  of this tree create a realistic look, gently swaying in the wind  to evoke the feeling of a natural outdoor environment. Whether displayed on its own or paired with other decorative elements , it will stand out as a focal point in any room .
Easy Decor Upgrade with Natural Style! Choose this artificial olive tree  to bring a touch of green beauty and Mediterranean charm ⛱ to your home  or office !
